description: Returns the public booking route for a business. Use this before helping a user book an appointment: it distinguishes an external provider page from an active configured calendar that uses the Advocate booking flow, and from businesses with no supported booking destination. For native mode, booking_backend names the calendar Advocate books into and capabilities states whether availability, booking, cancellation and rescheduling are supported through Advocate. External pages are links only; Advocate does not sync their availability or make bookings there.
name: get_booking_destination

booking_backend.description: Native mode only: which calendar Advocate books into for this business.

capabilities.description: Native mode only: what an agent can complete through Advocate for this backend. Unsupported actions have no tool; do not claim them.

title: Get Booking Destination
